                  [32m'  private highestSentSeq: number = 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  private isLive = false;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  private isClosed = false;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  constructor(id: string, room: string, writer: any, initialSeq: number) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.id = id;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.room = room;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.writer = writer;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.highestSentSeq = initialSeq;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Called by the broker when a new message is published\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  public handleMessage(message: Message) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (this.isClosed) return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (this.isLive) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      this.sendOrQueue(message);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      this.queue.push(message);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  private async sendOrQueue(message: Message) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (message.seq <= this.highestSentSeq) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      return; // Skip duplicate\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.highestSentSeq = message.seq;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      const sseString = `id: ${message.seq}\\nevent: message\\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        room: message.room,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        seq: message.seq,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        user: message.user,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        text: message.text,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        ts: message.ts\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      })}\\n\\n`;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await this.writer.write(this.encoder.encode(sseString));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Stream might be closed or aborted\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // Called after replay messages have been sent\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  public async transitionToLive(replayMessages: Message[]) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // 1. Send all replay messages\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const msg of replayMessages) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await this.sendOrQueue(msg);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // 2. Mark as live\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.isLive = true;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // 3. Drain queue\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const pending = this.queue;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.queue = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    for (const msg of pending) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      await this.sendOrQueue(msg);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  public close() {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (this.isClosed) return;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    this.isClosed = true;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    try {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      this.writer.releaseLock();\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } catch (err) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      // Ignore\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'}\n'[39m +
